subject: Observability onboarding: alert triage cadence & runbook alignment
body:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Gupta <maya@cloudside.com>, ops@cloudside.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Observability onboarding kickoff + proposed checklist

Hi Maya / CloudSide ops team,

Thanks again for confirming the kickoff for next week. Attached is a slimmed-down onboarding checklist focused on the observability deliverables we discussed: dashboards, tracing hooks, error taxonomy, alert routing, and the initial runbook draft. Goal is for Redwood and CloudSide to agree on cadence and owners so your SREs can start routing alerts into PagerDuty with the right triage steps.

Key asks in this email:
- Review the attached Alert-Taxonomy spreadsheet and flag any mappings that differ from your internal naming.
- Confirm two SREs who will own initial triage during the 30-day ramp.
- Pick a weekly 30-min sync cadence (we propose Tue 10:00am PT).

Attachments: CS-Onboarding-Checklist-v2.pdf, Alert-Taxonomy-v1.xlsx, runbook-first-draft.md

Next steps: Laura and I will run a short walkthrough of the dashboard wireframes in the kickoff. Ben will share the tracing hook integration checklist after kickoff.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

-----

From: Maya Gupta <maya@cloudside.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@cloudside.com, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff + proposed checklist

Laura — thanks, received. A few quick notes after a first pass on the taxonomy:
- We have an existing "auth.token.failure" family that our SREs treat as P1 during deploy windows; your sheet classifies those as P2. Can we keep that as P1?
- Tracing hooks: we use OpenTelemetry (Go & Node) and would like Redwood to provide an example middleware snippet for both runtimes.
- Owners: assigning myself and Raj Patel (raj@cloudside.com) as triage contacts for the first 30 days.

Wed 10am PT works for the sync if you can confirm.

Maya
VP Ops, CloudSide Inc.

-----

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Gupta <maya@cloudside.com>, ops@cloudside.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff + proposed checklist

Thanks Maya — great callouts. Quick responses: 
- Alert severity: agree to keep "auth.token.failure" family as P1 during deploy windows. We'll add a time-bound rule in the taxonomy sheet to capture deploy windows.
- Tracing hooks: Ben will attach Go & Node snippets to the shared Drive before the Wed sync.
- Sync: confirmed Wed, 10:00am PT. I'll send calendar invite and an agenda focused on the 4 deliverables.

Agenda (30 mins):
1) Dashboard wireframe walkthrough (10m) — Laura
2) Tracing integration approach + middleware snippets (8m) — Ben
3) Alert taxonomy finalization & routing plan (7m) — Hannah
4) Runbook handoff timeline and owners (5m) — Laura

Action: Ben, please post the tracing snippets and a short checklist for patching the Redwood client on instrumented services.

Hannah
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Maya Gupta <maya@cloudside.com>
Cc: ops@cloudside.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff + proposed checklist

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 08:21 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Maya — great callouts. Quick responses: 
> - Alert severity: agree to keep "auth.token.failure" family as P1 during deploy windows. We'll add a time-bound rule in the taxonomy sheet to capture deploy windows.
> - Tracing hooks: Ben will attach Go & Node snippets to the shared Drive before the Wed sync.
> - Sync: confirmed Wed, 10:00am PT. I'll send calendar invite and an agenda focused on the 4 deliverables.

I've added two small artifacts to the drive folder:
- tracing-middleware-go.example (snippet)
- tracing-middleware-node.example (snippet)
- client-patch-checklist.md (6 steps for rolling the patched client)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Onboard-CloudSide-Observability

Note on tracing: we recommend instrumenting service entry points and the Redwood client calls with a span annotation named "redwood.model.call" and include model_id and latency_ms attributes. That will let you correlate model latency spikes with trace traces and surface them on dashboards.

Ben
Platform Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Maya Gupta <maya@cloudside.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff + proposed checklist

Received and reviewed the snippets — they look good. A couple of logistics from our side before Wed's meeting:
- Our SREs want the initial dashboard to show (1) 95/99 latency per route, (2) error rate by error taxonomy family, (3) model fallback events, and (4) cost per 1k tokens (approx). Can you include a baseline dashboard template for those four tiles?
- Runbook: we prefer runbooks in markdown and attached to our internal Confluence page. Would it be possible for Redwood to provide the runbook-first-draft.md as a starting template we can copy into Confluence?

We'll be on the Wed 10am PT call. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Maya

-----

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Gupta <maya@cloudside.com>, ops@cloudside.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff + proposed checklist

Thanks all — great meeting today. Short thread summary and confirmed owners/timeboxes: 

Summary:
- Dashboard template: Ben exported a baseline dashboard JSON and dropped it into the drive link. It contains tiles for 95/99 latency by route, error-rate by taxonomy family, model fallback events, and token-cost estimate.
- Tracing: go/node middleware snippets published. Please instrument service entry and all outbound Redwood client calls with span name "redwood.model.call".
- Alert taxonomy: we updated Alert-Taxonomy-v1.xlsx to mark "auth.token.failure" as P1 for deploy windows (08:00-12:00 local).
- Runbook: Laura pushed runbook-first-draft.md to the shared Drive; it's licensed as a template — feel free to copy into Confluence and send us the Confluence link when done.

Confirmed owners & cadence:
- CloudSide triage owners (30 days): Maya Gupta, Raj Patel (raj@cloudside.com)
- Redwood owners: Laura Bennett (runbook & dashboard), Ben Carter (tracing & instrumentation checklist), Hannah Schmitt (alert routing config + escalation path)
- Sync cadence: weekly Tue 10:00am PT, 30 minutes (first 4 weeks then biweekly ramp down)

Open action items (owners):
- CloudSide: copy runbook-first-draft.md into Confluence and share link (Maya) — due Mon 2026-11-30
- Ben: add example queries for the dashboard tiles and a JSON export (Ben) — due Fri 2026-12-04
- Hannah: implement the alert-routing policy in the staging account and share the routing rules (Hannah) — due Tue 2026-12-01
- Laura: update taxonomy sheet with any CloudSide edits after Confluence runbook is posted (Laura) — due Mon 2026-11-30

Attachments referenced: CS-Onboarding-Checklist-v2.pdf; Alert-Taxonomy-v1.xlsx; runbook-first-draft.md

If anything above is off, reply-all and we'll correct; otherwise I'll close the onboarding kickoff ticket and move the action items into INF-2345.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
